places.name: Cofetăria Suprem
places.evidence: Family project founded 2018; founder's mother was a pastry chef since 1974; website tells personal family story; won Firma de Aur 2022 and Șoimii Gastronomiei award; described as artisan family-run atelier

places.name: Casa Romașcană by One
places.evidence: Owner Viliu Farcaș documented in Mesagerul Neamț interview (2015); personally managed 4-year renovation; described his hands-on vision for the Baroque building; actively manages property and investment decisions

places.name: Cofetăria Delicia
places.evidence: Operated by SC Jora Service SRL (est. 1993); administrator personally manages all departments per Romanul Financiar profile; won 1st place Topul Firmelor Nemțene 2021 micro-enterprise category; long-running local family-scale operation
